notes.content:

Here a list of updates for DNA and new integrations :

- A board of Upgrades for the player (minimum 14 skills to unloack and improves)
- Add fog and 3 types of rain (wind and thunder in the futur)
- Total rework of HUD
- Vendor mechanic (sell and buy all types of items)

and more...

In the next few days, I will update the screenshots of the Steam page of DNA

Thanks for reading the survivors !
Don't forget you can play to DNA in joining my Discord ;)

- Fogrim Studio

notes.title: News of the game and opening of my Discord !
notes.content:
It's been almost 1 year since I posted any news on Steam ! And yet I continue day after day to develop DNA <3

I have to admit, in the development of DNA there is at least one thing I do not do well: communicating the progress of the game on Steam ːsteamsaltyː So let's forget about the [i]survivors news[/i] and get to the facts:

Some time after the Covid arrived, I decided to create a mobile game (a clicker) in order to familiarize myself a bit with mobile games, I was a bit overworked on elements related to gameplay and the progressive opening of the map in DNA and I figured that releasing this mobile game could also give it some visibility... Well yes, developing a game is good, but it's better if there are players to play it ! :D

My 2 main goals are to release a demo as soon as possible and a teaser !
A demo to get your feedback, will make the game experience much better!
I already said it but my project is ambitious for a solo developer, I need time !

In the meantime here are some additions (finished or in progress) in DNA :
- 2 new grenades (smoke and stun)
- total redesign of the beginning of the game! :o The story doesn't start the same way anymore !
- animation of zombies (sleeping and animation of their death by bullet impact)
- the player will slightly change his appearance (he looked like Steve from Minecraft)
- almost all place names in the city/map have been fixed, as well as their environment (almost 30 levels)
- more "intelligence" improvements of the enemies
- scenery ... and more

I open my Discord if you want to see the development of DNA, or just chat ːsteamhappyː This is where I am most active! :D

notes.title: Survivor News ! #2 📚
notes.content:
[h3]In the previous post, I announced that I wanted to post news more often to keep you informed of DNA's development. So they will be called "Survivor News" which I will try to publish at least once a month!

In these news[b] I won't list[/b] all the minor changes and additions in the game, nor bug fixes (the game is not public yet) but only what can be [b]notable and interesting[/b] to you in the daily progress of DNA !

Most important information :
- All the colors of the game are now duller and gray.
- I am currently fine-tuning some elements that I would like to integrate in the future first teaser! [/h3]

Additions:

- New machine pistol (HK MP5)
- The Screen Shake when firing and explosions is different and has been increased
- More blood particles, debris (when shooting into walls)
- The hero is more animated during interactions (door/search/item pickup)
- Indicates on the screen a found piece of map, a new mission, a successful mission.
- Progress on level design (especially housing)
- Additions of English text translations for the future Teaser
- NPCs offer different types of missions, sometimes with rewards

List of reflections and tests :
- Best "personality and visual identification" of the hero.
- Ability to sort the inventory by item type (food/care/weapons/quest items or rare) in addition to the other types of quick sorting already present.
- Human enemies communications + weapon changes
- Style of electro music present in the game
- And finally opening of my Discord in public (for the Francophones at first, no date there too for the moment)

Don't hesitate to leave a like of encouragement if this kind of news interests you ;)
